title: Add downgrade guard, backup/restore hooks, and version-pinning to private-installer upgrade tooling
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: harden the private-installer upgrade path for VPC/on-prem customers by adding a downgrade guard, explicit version-pinning for helm/chart/terraform artifacts, automated pre-upgrade backup+post-rollback restore hooks, and safe schema migration ordering to avoid unrecoverable downgrades. This PR implements: 1) upgrade-manager: version_pin enforcement, pre-upgrade dry-run and validation checks, and an explicit migration_version_lock to prevent accidental downgrades; 2) backup/restore hooks: installer hooks to take postgres dumps and etcd snapshots (with optional s3/gcs/azure upload) before running migrations and a restore command path that is invoked automatically on failed upgrades; 3) schema migrations: split migrations into forward-only and reversible groups, add migration metadata to detect irreversible steps and block downgrades unless operator-approved; 4) helm charts: chart hooks and values (charts/private-installer) to register backup/restore lifecycle and expose upgrade.auto and version_pin variables; 5) terraform: module variable version_pin and lifecycle hooks to coordinate plan/apply during upgrades; 6) tests/docs: new integration tests in perf-canary and doc updates docs/internal/upgrade.md. Checklist: - [x] unit tests for upgrade-manager validation - [x] integration tests covering backup/restore roundtrip - [x] e2e canary for upgrade->rollback path - [x] docs/upgrade guide updated - [x] Linear tickets referenced (ENG-1823, ENG-1840). Rollout plan: merge to main, cut release branch, run canary on internal staging with a small subset of clusters, monitor metrics and automatic rollback on failure, then schedule broader customers. Backward compatibility: operators can opt out of automated workflows via values.upgrade.auto=false; manual upgrades behave as before. Caveats: restores of incompatible manual schema edits still require operator intervention; downgrade guard will require an operator override with audit log. See docs/internal/upgrade.md and charts/private-installer/README.md for operator instructions.
